meta.name: nuclei template-tags + severity snapshot (KA-027)
meta.provenance: Curated from the real nuclei template ecosystem conventions (severity scale; the tag families) + this repo's own recorded nuclei rows (the KA-003/K A-011 fixtures). This is the committed anti-drift reference: the parser's severity mapping is pinned against it; upstream schema evolution (key drift) is pinned in KA-011.

critical.convention: pre-auth RCE, data exfiltration, crash of the whole service

high.convention: authed RCE, significant information disclosure, auth bypass

unknown.convention: the parser's documented no-bucket case: listed, never counted

template_tags.cve: tags carrying actual CVE ids (cves/<year>/<id> template paths)
